video_analyses.title: Diamond Jubilee (60 Years) & Campus Aerial Flyover
video_analyses.summary_of_speech: The narration celebrates six decades of transformative learning (1966 to 2026). It highlights the core ethos that true education develops minds that think, hearts that care, and leaders of high moral character. It reflects on the thousands of student journeys that originated in these classrooms and athletic fields.
video_analyses.what_is_happening: High-definition aerial drone flyover starting over the expansive green sports turf, gliding past the colonial multi-gabled Heritage Manor, sweeping across the academic classroom verandas, and panning toward the misty forested slopes of Shankaracharya Hill.
topics_discussed: Evolution into Kashmir's leading academic institution
Holistic synthesis of scholastic rigor and sportsmanship
video_analyses.upcoming_events_mentioned: Diamond Jubilee Grand Alumni Conclave scheduled on campus grounds.

video_analyses.title: Science & Art Exhibition: Innovation Beyond Classroom
video_analyses.summary_of_speech: Student presenters and faculty supervisors elaborate on experiential learning where theory meets practice. Senior students discuss working prototypes covering clean energy, robotic automation, biochemical assays, and artistic interpretations of Kashmir's biodiversity.
video_analyses.what_is_happening: Close-up inspections of chemistry titration burettes, physics circuitry, biological diagrams, and students confidently presenting empirical findings to academic supervisors and visiting scholars.
topics_discussed: Modernized chemistry, physics, and biology research wing

video_analyses.title: Alumni Voices: Foundations of Character
video_analyses.summary_of_speech: Distinguished alumni, including hospitality pioneer Mr. Rohit Khattar (Founder, Indian Accent) and senior healthcare executive Dr. Raies Khan (Batch of 1994, Paras Health / Shalby Hospitals), recount how the school's culture of discipline, humility, and critical thinking laid the bedrock for their national and international careers.
video_analyses.what_is_happening: Cinematic sweeps of the colonial administrative facade, the Chairman's historic study, and archival photographs spanning 60 years of student cohorts.
topics_discussed: Dr. Raies Khan's 20-year healthcare leadership journey
Mr. Rohit Khattar's pioneering role in luxury hospitality
Adnan Shah's entrepreneurship journey from the Batch of 2005
video_analyses.upcoming_events_mentioned: Launch of the Global Alumni Mentorship Fellowship for Class 10 graduates.
